highlights.description: **Breaking**: the Go module path is now `github.com/plexusone/systemspec-deploy`
The project joins the SystemSpec family as its deployment topology specification; the document format, CLI and graphize provider are unchanged

breaking.description: The generated JSON Schema `$id` is now `https://github.com/plexusone/systemspec-deploy/schema/system`

documentation.description: Updated README, MkDocs site and SDK guides for the new module path and repository
Added a migration guide for moving from `github.com/plexusone/system-spec`

highlights.description: Initial release of system-spec: a Go-native system topology specification
Multi-format rendering: D2, Mermaid, Cytoscape.js, Sigma.js, GraphViz DOT

added.description: Core spec types: System, Service, GitRepo, ContainerImage
AWS resource bindings: RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, S3, Bedrock
GCP resource bindings: CloudSQL, PubSub, GCS
Service connectivity modeling with protocol and port
Deployment mappings for Helm charts and Terraform modules
D2 renderer with styled node shapes
Cytoscape.js JSON renderer for web visualization
Sigma.js JSON renderer optimized for large graphs
JSON Schema generation from Go types
CLI tool: validate, render, schema, graph commands
Graphize provider for integrating with code graph databases

documentation.description: Specification document v0.1.0 with full type definitions
